title: 빈자리가 날 봐
suno_analysis_sp: K-pop dance-pop track in G major at 124 BPM. The arrangement features a prominent slap bass line with syncopated sixteenth-note patterns and a bright, percussive character. A clean, funk-style electric guitar plays rhythmic muted strums and staccato chords. The drums consist of a punchy kick, a crisp snare with a short decay, and shimmering hi-hats. Bright polyphonic synth pads provide harmonic support during the chorus, while a plucky synth lead adds melodic accents. The female vocals are clear and melodic, utilizing a mix of chest voice and light head voice in the higher register. Production includes subtle vocal doubling and a polished, high-fidelity mix with moderate compression on the master bus.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[slap bass enters, funk guitar scratching, electronic percussion]

[Verse 1]
[female vocals]
문 열리면 고개 돌아가 [kick drum enters]
반사야 어쩔 수 없어
빈자리 확인했어
오늘도 안 왔어 [snare hits on 2 and 4]
출석부 넘어가는데
심장이 더 크게 뛰어
혹시 복도에 있을까
핸드폰만 만져
아무것도 안 들려

[Chorus]
[full arrangement, synth pads swell]
빈자리가 날 봐
나만 이러는 거지
옆자리 하나에 하루가 흔들려
비
